title: Rational Resistance
statementMd:
Mad scientist Mike is building a time machine in his spare time. To finish the work, he needs a resistor with a certain resistance value.

However, all Mike has is lots of identical resistors with unit resistance $*R*_{0} = 1$. Elements with other resistance can be constructed from these resistors. In this problem, we will consider the following as elements:

1. one resistor;
2. an element and **one** resistor plugged in sequence;
3. an element and **one** resistor plugged in parallel.

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/249f698ce0d3719cb8e438a16a1349fe8a3a1aa5.png)

With the consecutive connection the resistance of the new element equals $*R* = *R*_{*e*} + *R*_{0}$. With the parallel connection the resistance of the new element equals ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/8e69f2f9d85e6584607971a68a207b22774fdf76.png). In this case $*R*_{*e*}$ equals the resistance of the element being connected.

Mike needs to assemble an element with a resistance equal to the fraction ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/58deb68a92272d09bf8f758a3c1e806b2e2c92b5.png). Determine the smallest possible number of resistors he needs to make such an element.

## Input

The single input line contains two space-separated integers $*a*$ and $*b*$ ($1 ≤ *a*, *b* ≤ 10^{18}$). It is guaranteed that the fraction ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/58deb68a92272d09bf8f758a3c1e806b2e2c92b5.png) is irreducible. It is guaranteed that a solution always exists.

## Output

Print a single number — the answer to the problem.

Please do not use the `%lld` specifier to read or write 64-bit integers in С++. It is recommended to use the `cin`, `cout` streams or the `%I64d` specifier.

## Note

In the first sample, one resistor is enough.

In the second sample one can connect the resistors in parallel, take the resulting element and connect it to a third resistor consecutively. Then, we get an element with resistance ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/5305da389756aab6423d918a08ced468f05604df.png). We cannot make this element using two resistors.
statementZhMd:
疯狂科学家 Mike 利用业余时间制造一台时间机器。为了完成这项工作，他需要一个具有特定电阻值的电阻器。

然而，Mike 只有大量电阻值均为 $*R*_{0} = 1$ 的相同电阻器。利用这些电阻器可以构造出具有其他电阻值的元件。在本题中，我们将以下物体视为元件：

1. 一个电阻器；
2. 一个元件与**一个**电阻器串联；
3. 一个元件与**一个**电阻器并联。

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/249f698ce0d3719cb8e438a16a1349fe8a3a1aa5.png)

串联时，新元件的电阻为 $*R* = *R*_{*e*} + *R*_{0}$。并联时，新元件的电阻为 ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/8e69f2f9d85e6584607971a68a207b22774fdf76.png)。其中，$*R*_{*e*}$ 表示被连接元件的电阻。

Mike 需要组装出一个电阻等于分数 ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/58deb68a92272d09bf8f758a3c1e806b2e2c92b5.png) 的元件。请确定构造出这样的元件所需的最少电阻器数量。

## 输入格式

输入仅一行，包含两个用空格分隔的整数 $*a*$ 和 $*b*$（$1 ≤ *a*, *b* ≤ 10^{18}$）。保证分数 ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/58deb68a92272d09bf8f758a3c1e806b2e2c92b5.png) 已约分。保证一定存在解。

## 输出格式

输出一个整数，即题目的答案。

请不要在 С++ 中使用 `%lld` 格式说明符读写 64 位整数。推荐使用 `cin`、`cout` 流，或使用 `%I64d` 格式说明符。

## 说明

在第一个样例中，一个电阻器就足够了。

在第二个样例中，可以先将电阻器并联，得到一个元件，再将该元件与第三个电阻器串联。这样就能得到一个电阻为 ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/5305da389756aab6423d918a08ced468f05604df.png) 的元件。使用两个电阻器无法构造出这个元件。
